title: Loupe configuration
description: Maps an app's Swift packages and targets onto the roles of the architecture that Loupe checks. See `loupe rules` for the rules themselves.

version.description: The version of this file's format.

packages.description: The Swift packages in the architecture, by role. Packages that are not listed are not checked.

utilities.description: Self-contained utilities that any package may depend on, plus the TestSupport target that only test targets may use.

coreInterface.description: Domain models and protocols that Presentation consumes.

crossInterface.description: Cross-cutting concerns such as logging and analytics.

presentationInterface.description: Scene protocols and view-ready data shapes (Prism: SceneInterface).

core.description: Domain logic, one folder per feature: <Feature>/<Feature><Role>/.

presentation.description: Implements the presentation interface and bridges Core to the UI.

exclude.description: Source paths Loupe skips, such as generated code. Every entry says why.

glob.description: A path relative to this file. `*` and `?` match within one path component; `**` matches any number of components.

path.description: The package directory, relative to this file.

target.description: The main target, when it isn't named like the package directory.

testSupport.description: The target of test-only helpers. Only test targets may depend on it.

target.description: The main target, when it isn't named like the package directory.

testDoubles.description: The target holding test doubles for this interface's protocols.

target.description: The main target, when it isn't named like the package directory.

routingTestDoubles.description: The target holding test doubles for the routing protocols that live in the presentation package.
